functions.name: Find
functions.doc: The layer called `name`, as a mask of that one layer, or no layer (RenderLayerMask.None) when no layer has that name. The match is exact and case-sensitive, against the names the editor shows: an unnamed layer answers to "Default" (layer 0) or "Layer N". Look a name up once, at a system's start, and keep the mask.

functions.name: NameOf
functions.doc: The name of the one layer in `layer`: its project name, else "Default" for layer 0 and "Layer N" for the others. A mask of no layer or of several layers has no name: the text is empty.
